resultEvidence.title: This Acti9 iPRD1 C25r surge arrester protects industrial and tertiary buildings installations against direct and indirect transient overvoltages. This is a 3P modular device with a 1+2 surge arrester class type without a surge adapted backup fuse. It can be associated to a 315A fusible disconnect device with a gG fuse. it offers a remote monitoring and also a front face local signalling with a green flag when the device is opeartional and with a red flag when the device needs to be changed. This prewired surge arrester allows quick replacement of withdrawable cartridges when they are damaged. It is compatible with TN-C earthing system. It works on a Ue rated operational voltage of 240V AC under a frequency of 50Hz or 60 Hz. The Uc maximum continuous operating voltage is 275VAC. The In nominal discharge current is 25kA growing to a Imax maximum discharge current of 65kA. The Iimp impulse current is 25kA. The Up voltage protection level is 1.5kV. It is clipped on the DIN rail. The dimensions are (W) 54mm x (H) 105mm x (D) 86mm and offers more place to mount other devices on DIN rail due to its compact width. The weight is 508g. The IP degree of protection is IP20. The operating temperature is -40°C to +85°C. This product complies with the EN 61643-11 standard with the 2011, 2012 and A11:2018 amendment.

resultEvidence.title: This Acti9 iID product is a modular and reliable residual current circuit breaker (RCCB). It is a 2P circuit breaker with 100A In rated current, 100mA earth leakage sensitivity, and A type protection class. This product protects against electrical shock by indirect contact and fire hazards. It performs the function of disconnection of electrical circuits in case of earth fault. Its unique Visitrip indicator reduces intervention time by showing the faulty device with a mechanical indicator on front face. This product also has a VisiSafe window with a green strip on the toggle indicating full opening of the poles allowing downstream maintenance This product complies with IEC 61008-2-1 and AS/NZS 61008.1 standards. It has RCM and VDE quality labels. The (Im/IΔm) rated breaking and making short circuit capacity is 1500A. The (Inc/IΔc) conditional rated short circuit current is 10kA. It has an electrical endurance going up to 15000 cycles and a mechanical endurance going up to 20000 cycles. The Ue rated operational voltage is from 230VAC to 240VAC with an operating frequency of 50Hz to 60Hz. The Ui rated insulation voltage is 500VAC with an operating frequency of 50Hz to 60Hz. The Uimp rated impulse withstand voltage of 6kV. It can be mounted on DIN rail for modular installation. The width in 9mm pitches is 4. The dimensions are (W) 36mm x (H) 96mm x (D) 69mm. The product colour is white. The product weight is 0.21kg. The IP degree of protection is IP20 and becomes IP40 once in a modular enclosure. The operating temperature is from -25°C to +60°C. The storage temperature is from -40°C to +85°C.

resultEvidence.title: This ABL8 regulated switch mode power supply (SMPS) supplies direct current voltage. It has a rated input of 100V to 500V AC, a rated output current of 5A at 24V DC and a rated power output of 120W. Most of these power supplies have auto protection reset. A few have auto / manual protection reset. Some of these power supplies can be mounted directly to a panel. It is also equipped with a PFC (Power Factor Correction) filter. It has LED diagnostics indicator available in the front for troubleshooting instantly. Automatic reset allows short-term faults to be cleared and systems to restart without the need to disturb on-duty maintenance engineers. It installs on DIN rail and is 56mm-wide. It weighs 0,700kg. It is a power supply for industrial use, rail mounting. It conforms to UL 508, CSA C22.2 No 60950-1 standards. The GB2CD07, GB2CD08, GV2RT06 and GV2ME06 thermal magnetic circuit breakers are recommanded for its protection. It has LED diagnostics indicator available in the front for troubleshooting instantly. It installs on DIN rail. It brings energy to your automated systems. Designed for simple machines and applications, modular power supplies are primarily appreciated for their extreme compactness.

The GB2CD07, GB2CD08, GV2RT06 and GV2ME06 thermal magnetic circuit breakers are recommanded for its protection. It has LED diagnostics indicator available in the front for troubleshooting instantly. It installs on DIN rail. It brings energy to your automated systems. Designed for simple machines and applications, modular power supplies are primarily appreciated for their extreme compactness.
